text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=\"inference-embedder-prod\" severity=2 PD=PGD-8921 region=us-west-2 symptoms=\"increased 5xx and elevated p99 latency\" auto_escalation=true

sam: reading it now — taking ownership. starting timeline+impact. anyone on-call in eu if we need cross-region failover?

arjun: on it with you, sam. looking at kv cache and batch queue. seen anything in logs yet?

opsbot: auto-collect initiated: 
- pinging metrics (prometheus.query)
- collecting last 30m controller logs
- collecting model_server logs (tail 500 lines)
(opsbot: run-id=ops-1746501234-collect)

marta: (reaction :eyes:) I can help with scaling dedicated pool if we need a quick capacity bump. have a warm pool ready in us-west.

sam: thanks @marta — please standby. arjun, quick check: is this likely kv-cache eviction storm or model-server overload?

arjun: early signs look like KV cache churn + a spike in long-running generator calls. sample from model server logs:
```
2025-03-24T14:02:11Z model_server.go: WARN kv_cache_miss_rate=0.78 req_id=abc123 latency_ms=2021 error=\"rpc: code=13 desc=deadline exceeded\"
2025-03-24T14:02:12Z model_server.go: ERROR handler=generate timeout after 2100ms active_batches=34 queued=18
2025-03-24T14:02:13Z router.go: WARN route=embedder-16 instance=gw-11 queue_wait_ms=450
```

sam: ok that aligns with customer reports (timeouts). Ops runbook step 1: try temporary routing to fallback model variant (lower memory) + reduce max_seq to drop cost per request. arjun, can you push fallback?

arjun: initiating rollback/fallback policy: routing 20% traffic to embedder-v1-quant (compatible) and reduce max_seq to 512 for incoming requests. command:
```
# routing change
redwoodctl rollout set traffic --service inference-embedder-prod --variant embedder-v1-quant --percent 20
# enforce per-route override
redwoodctl config apply --service inference-embedder-prod --route /generate --max_seq 512
```

opsbot: autoscaler snapshot shows spike in CPU and GPU utilization across pool embedder-prod-usw2: gpu_util ~ 92%, pending_scale_up=2 nodes, current_pending_provision= provisioning-queue-3.

marta: provisioning extra nodes now. ETA ~ 3m for new VMs, then GPU warm-start ~ 1m. scaling will give breathing room while fallback ramp continues.

sam: good. also turning on stricter early timeouts at the API gateway to reduce head-of-line blocking: gateway timeout -> 1.5s for embedder route (will return 429/early-cancel). Not ideal but stops cascading.

lina: FYI eu oncall here in case customers in eu start seeing issues — currently no major alerts in eu. if we end up failing over cross-region i'll take lead for eu traffic.

arjun: after routing change p50 latency improved slightly, but p99 still high. KV cache miss rate dropped from 0.78 to 0.52 after partial routing. logs show fewer rpc deadline errors.

sam: customer-impact note: Support reported ~120 unique requests affected in last 10m across 3 customers (mostly small PLG apps). no billing impact anomalies seen yet. documenting in incident ticket PGD-8921.

marta: new nodes came up, model instances warmed, and we saw immediate drop in 5xx. provisioning helped reduce queue depth.

opsbot: summary of automated checks (after mitigations):
- 5xx rate: from 1.6% -> 0.3% over 10m
- p99 latency: from 2.8s -> 1.4s (route max_seq=512 reduces tail)
- active_queue: from 120 -> 34
(opsbot: snapshot saved /incidents/1746501234/snap-1)

sam: thumbs, nice work. next: keep fallback at 20% for 15m, keep autoscaler up, and schedule canary ramp down gradually. arjun, once stable can you prepare plan to anneal cache eviction policy?

arjun: will open a short RFC + follow-up action item — likely increase KV cache size or adjust TTLs for hot prefixes.

lina: heading to lunch in 7m but reachable. if we need to hand off to eu oncall i'll join bridge.

marta: support notified customers with small blurb: \"We observed transient timeouts in inference-embedder in us-west affecting a small subset of customers. We’ve mitigated by routing traffic and scaling nodes; monitoring continues.\"

sam: timeline entry: 14:01 alert fired, 14:02 sam ack, 14:03 fallback routing applied, 14:06 autoscale nodes online, 14:10 metrics returning to baseline.

opsbot: incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. watch for recurrence in next 30m. PD ticket PGD-8921 updated with notes and links to logs.

arjun: will follow up with a short post-incident note in #postmortems once we have root cause. expected RC: cache eviction churn under bursty long-gen load.

sam: closing loop here — remaining action items: (1) arjun: cache tuning RFC (2) infra: test autoscale warm pool playbook (marta) (3) devex: add a synthetic check for kv miss spike (sam). will re-open if we see re-alert.

marta: (reaction :white_check_mark:)

lina: thanks team, I’ll pick this up if anything pops.

pagerbot: PD incident PGD-8921 -> status: resolved (mitigated) at 1746501540. link: https://pagerduty.example/PGD-8921

sam: incident thread closed for now — will post the postmortem link when available.
